R0285.title: Trading Indicator and Ranking Misleading
R0285.definition: Attackers manipulate volume, rankings, index weights, block-trade display, or benchmarks to create false market heat, authority, or trade-quality signals.
R0285.description:
Trading indicator and ranking misleading occurs in rankings, indices, leader boards, block trades, volume, heat scores, recommendation positions, and benchmark mechanisms. Attackers use wash-like activity, index-weight misleading, ranking manipulation, block-trade illusion, or benchmark gaming so investors and models believe an instrument is more active, authoritative, or institutionally endorsed.

The harm is that manipulated derivative indicators are packaged as objective market signals. If platforms, media, or trading systems use those indicators for recommendation, ranking, risk control, or strategy inputs, the false signal is amplified.
R0285.influence: It misleads investors and quant models into using polluted indicators, amplifying chasing, copy-trading, rebalancing, and wrong risk assessment.

observables: Rankings, heat scores, or index weights do not match real execution quality
Block-trade display is used to imply institutional endorsement
Indicator spikes are followed by concentrated exits or reverse trades
Recommendation or ranking inputs are artificially boosted in short windows
